conditions: The range expression has one of the listed function core types and satisfies the other requirements of a range clause.
limitations: The callback arity determines the available iteration values. This does not permit functions with arbitrary arguments or result values.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: Go 1.23 permits a function as a range expression when its core type is func(func() bool), func(func(V) bool), or func(func(K, V) bool).
